literal_meaning: শহুরে রাস্তাঘাটের জটিল গোলমাল (urban maze or labyrinth)
example_sentences_in_bangla: শহরের গোলকধাঁধায় ঢুকে দিশাহারা হয়ে গেলাম।
example_sentences_in_english: I got disoriented in the city's maze of streets.
Everyone feels lost in the labyrinth of life.
history: Often referenced in Bengali songs and literature depicting urban bewilderment, such as in the lyric 'শহরতারে গোলকধাঁধায় আঁধার হল মন'.
note: This idiom evokes the complexity of city navigation and is culturally tied to experiences of migration to urban areas in Bengal.
